description: This file is a Node.js script that wraps around the 'expo start' command, normalizing host options and environment variables to facilitate starting an Expo development server in various preview environments. It manages host mode resolution based on environment variables, constructs command-line arguments, and spawns a subprocess to execute the 'expo' CLI with the configured options.

methods.name: resolveHostMode()
methods.description: Determines the host mode ('lan', 'tunnel', 'localhost') based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: buildArgs()
methods.description: Constructs the argument array for the 'expo start' command, incorporating host mode and platform flags.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Executes the spawn process to start the Expo server with the constructed arguments and environment configuration.
